name: Dental Laboratory Operations
audience: independent dental laboratories serving local dental practices
topic: case intake, esthetic approval, and remake-learning workflows

products.name: Case Intake Completeness
products.product: A focused dental lab case intake validation workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent dental laboratories serving local dental practices
products.problem: A case enters production with a missing or conflicting prescription, scan, impression, photos, material, shade, due date, shipping detail, or practice instruction, causing later stops and remakes.
products.valueProposition: Turns dental lab case intake validation into a visible operating queue so every lab case is accepted only after a trained reviewer confirms the required prescription, files, materials, dates, and practice clarifications.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets dental lab case intake, dental lab prescription tracking, dental case validation, and dental laboratory workflow searches.

products.name: Esthetic Approval Queue
products.product: A focused dental lab shade and design approval tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent dental laboratories serving local dental practices
products.problem: Shade photos, design previews, try-in feedback, practice questions, patient scheduling, revised files, and final release can create ambiguous approval versions during esthetic cases.
products.valueProposition: Turns dental lab shade and design approval tracking into a visible operating queue so every requested esthetic or design decision is tied to a specific review artifact, authorized practice response, effective version, and production release.
products.topic: dental lab shade and design approval tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets dental lab shade approval, dental design approval, dental lab doctor portal, and esthetic case workflow searches.

products.name: Remake Cause Register
products.product: A focused dental laboratory remake cause tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent dental laboratories serving local dental practices
products.problem: Remakes are opened as replacement cases while fit issue, intake quality, prescription change, material, design, production step, shipping damage, practice handling, and disposition remain unstructured.
products.valueProposition: Turns dental laboratory remake cause tracking into a visible operating queue so every remake receives a respectful evidence-based operational review, explicit responsibility and commercial treatment, and a prevention action when warranted.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets dental lab remake tracking, dental laboratory quality software, dental case remake form, and dental lab remake rate searches.
